title: The 'What my gym can see' page says MettleUp never sends which exercises you did, even while the member shares workouts with gym mates
what: In a gym without busy machines or the trainer view, the page opens with: MettleUp never sends which exercises you did, your body weight, photos or notes. Right under it sits the switch to let gym mates see your workouts. When that switch is on, the app sends up to 30 workouts with each exercise's name and best set, and other members can open them. The page keeps the never-sends-exercises line while this is happening. The switch's own caption tells the truth, so the page says two different things.
expected: While gym-mate sharing is on (or can be switched on), the page uses the line without the exercises claim, as it already does for busy machines and the trainer view.
who: members of a gym with gym-mate profiles on
fix_line: Show the shorter line (no exercises claim) whenever gym-mate sharing is on or offered

title: Find my gym says we never message you, but MettleUp's WhatsApp number writes back after the check
what: The Find my gym screen tells the member: You pay nothing, and we never message you. When the member's WhatsApp message arrives, MettleUp's WhatsApp number sends a reply saying the number is verified, and a different reply when the code is missing. So the member does get a message from MettleUp, right after being told they never would.
expected: The screen's words match what happens, for example: We reply once to say it worked, and never message you after that.
who: members who use Find my gym
fix_line: Change the line to say MettleUp replies once to confirm, and never messages after that

items.reason: 11 promises. 25 (only the person you pick): kept for Ask about your workout, which uses its own question list where the owner sees a question only when asked to the owner, any trainer, or a trainer who has since been removed; the register's GAP came from the separate Message your gym path, whose own line says the owner can read it too. 28 (never sends exercises): untrue while gym-mate sharing is on (FN-L4-phone-shop-1-01). 29 (never body weight, photos or notes): kept, the leaderboard, trainer, mate and machine sends carry none (part 2 checked the recent-workouts send). 30 (busy machines, totals only): kept, the owner's view counts members per hour and never returns a name. 31 (staff always see your name): kept, the board rows carry the member's name for staff. 33 (asks only once): kept, the number is asked only when the server answers NO_PHONE and is then kept on the member's gym record. 39 (number not kept): P-A7-phone-watch-2-39 clashes with the notice's 2-day coded keep and the first name is also sent (FN-L4-phone-screens-1-01). 40 (we never message you): MettleUp's WhatsApp writes back (FN-L4-phone-shop-1-02). 41 (look as soon as it arrives): kept, the app asks every 3 seconds while open and again on return. Templates 26 and 27 (welcome, days added): kept, made on the phone from the plan and the offer, nothing sent.

Notice: two screen lines say less than happens (01, 02); Find my gym's not-kept line clashes with the notice (known). Consent: join needs the 18-or-older and notice tick before the Join button, but the join note does not name the sharing switched on at joining, which rests on legitimate interest (known part 2 finding). Purpose: the gym lead sends only gym name and city; the claim code is shown by the member and sent nowhere. Children: 18-or-older tick at join. Bring a friend: the friend's page is outside this area (known finding on that page). Deletion and breach timing: nothing here beyond leave.

Nothing in this area lets MettleUp staff read gym data: every read goes through the gym's functions with the member's own key. The hidden staff door signs in the gym's own owner or desk person, not MettleUp. MettleUp staff access lives on the server and HQ.

Phone side: leaving forgets the gym, inbox, kept plan, offer, reminders, diets and hours at once; the ask-reply store keeps only ids and a time. Find my gym keeps the proof in memory only. Server side: the mobile number typed at check-in stays in waiting and decided requests after leaving (known).

Outside companies reached from this area: Meta WhatsApp for the number check (named in the notice; its reply is finding 02), UPI apps and the gym's payment page for paying (payee, amount and note only; checked in part 2), the phone's share menu for Bring a friend and Tell my gym (the member picks where). The gym message sound plays the phone's own tone and sends nothing. No AI, analytics or health service is called here.

Leave in this area forgets the gym on the phone first and keeps only the key until the server hears it. What the server keeps after leaving or after Delete my account (check-in number in requests, trainer summary sent again late, gym-linked data the delete screen says is gone) is in known findings. Backups are not in this area.
